pairs.why: The two are nearly the same, but A's head is slightly more blue and has a bit less lens shine, so it sits a little closer to the real blue-and-silver viewer.
A is chunkier and more toy-like, with mirror-gloss lenses and added props, while B is the cleaner, neatly built viewer with proportions closer to the real one.
A's face is wide and swollen with oversized lenses, while B is the crisper, better-proportioned build.
A is puffy and glossy, with toy-like rounded wood and oversized seeds, while B has the flatter, cleaner planks of the real feeder.
Both are close, but A's plain gable box and smooth planks read a little more like the real feeder than B's arched cut-outs.
B adds metal bolts, a ring and a bracket that the real feeder lacks, while A keeps its simpler, smooth wooden build.
A matches the real card's main colours, dark navy keys with a cyan column, while B's large cream number keys change the overall colour look even though B has the printed labels.
A again keeps the real card's navy-and-cyan keys, while B's white keys break the main colour scheme, and the labels matter less than the colours.
